purpose: Contract for separating legal source from runtime state. Files and tests only. No relocation this slice.

kinds.definition: Canonical executable and schema that the branch must carry.
Contracts, seat map, change-authority policy, decisions. High churn does not make them runtime-only.
Receipts, reports, handoffs, certification packs with provenance.
Live worker heartbeats, leases, deliveries, session stamps. Must leave source tracking when P1 mutates.
Logs, audits, pulse traces. Out of Git.
Append-only cognitive/command WAL. Not a Git source of truth.
Backups, bak copies, editor debris. Isolate; delete only after proof.
Recovery snapshots. Archive before any delete.

law: gitignore-only is not the mutable-state solution
do not stop services outside a C1 quiescence window
LOCKS.json and TASKS.json remain GOVERNANCE until C1 authorizes a new control-plane store
WORKER-REGISTRY live heartbeat in the tree is RUNTIME_STATE, not LEGAL_SOURCE

observed_examples_not_moved.note: MESSAGE_PICKUP heartbeat and reported head live in the source tree
Shared control plane. Not relocated this slice. Not treated as disposable runtime.
